content.description: Standardized protocol for sharing context and capabilities between AI models and tools
references: Model Context Protocol Official Website - https://modelcontextprotocol.io

tldr.watchOut: Protocol overhead and versioning mismatches between client and server implementations can silently degrade or break tool availability.
tldr.what: Standardized protocol that lets AI models discover, describe, and use tools through structured context and capability exchange.
tldr.when: Systems needing multiple models to share tools, maintain session state, or hand off work across different AI services.
